procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: GBR 7355 and LTU 4 were approaching mark 3s, reaching on starboard tack below the layline.
Six boat lengths from the mark, GBR 7355 was clear ahead of LTU 4. 3, LTU luffed and goes to windward of GBR 7355.
GBR 7355 said the move was idiotic.
With a metre in between the boats, GBR 7355 slowly luffed; while LTU 4 was holding steady course.
When the boats were 30 cm apart, GBR 7355 stopped luffing and bore away.
conclusions: LTU 4 to windward failed to keep clear of GBR 7355 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
decision: LTU 4 is DSQ in race F1.
